settings.heading: ADJUSTABLE DUAL BALL MOUNT
settings.text: Designed for 2-inch receivers, this adjustable dual-ball trailer hitch offers up to 6 inches of height adjustment for a better towing setup. The dual-ball design adds versatility for different trailers and towing needs.

settings.heading: PRECISE DIMENSIONS & PERFECT FIT
settings.text: Built with practical dimensions for a secure and stable connection, this trailer hitch fits 2-inch receivers. The adjustable mounting positions make it easy to find the right height for your towing setup.

settings.heading: 6-INCH RISE & DROP ADJUSTMENT
settings.text: Easily switch between up to a 6-inch rise or 6-inch drop to keep your trailer properly aligned with your vehicle. The flexible height adjustment works well with vehicles and trailers of different heights.

settings.heading: EASY ASSEMBLY & DISASSEMBLY
settings.text: Designed with removable pins and locking components for quick installation and adjustment. The solid construction and chrome-plated ball mount provide a practical, durable setup for everyday towing.
